description: pg_lsn parsing, arithmetic, ordering, arrays, catalog metadata, protocol type inference, and WAL-position functions
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_lsn_values (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, position pg_lsn NOT NULL, positions pg_lsn[] NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_lsn_values VALUES (1, '10/0', ARRAY['0/1'::pg_lsn, 'FFFFFFFF/FFFFFFFF'::pg_lsn]), (2, 'F/FFFFFFFF', ARRAY['0/2'::pg_lsn]);
SELECT id, position::text, positions::text, pg_typeof(position) FROM type_matrix_lsn_values ORDER BY id;

SELECT pg_typeof(pg_current_wal_lsn()), pg_typeof(pg_current_wal_insert_lsn()), pg_typeof(pg_current_wal_flush_lsn()), pg_typeof(pg_wal_lsn_diff('0/10', '0/1')), pg_typeof(pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()), pg_typeof(pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()), pg_is_in_recovery();
SELECT oid, typname, typlen, typbyval, typalign, typstorage, typarray FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'pg_lsn';
